verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a payments platform, since some payment or orchestration products ship self-hostable cores, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Mollie's core can be self-hosted: checkout pages, the APIs and even the MCP server (mcp.mollie.com) are all Mollie-hosted. The Magento/WooCommerce modules run on the merchant's own e-commerce platform, which is a host-platform integration rather than self-hosting Mollie itself.
